about: What a top Lockout player knows: per goal the fastest ways (fastest first), what they need, when they work, and an expert's seconds for the tile (from deciding to go for it, with stone tools and a table in the pack, the place not yet known but at a typical distance; Nether tiles counted from inside the Nether). Per mob: how it comes about and Bob's seconds to kill one once found. Per structure: its chest tables and the seconds to loot it once there (the chances are rolled from the game's own loot tables at start). Written for Minecraft 26.3 and checked against its data (recipes, loot tables, spawn lists, trades). See docs/bob-reference-times.md.

shipwreck.note: beached or sunk at sea level; treasure chest at the stern (iron nearly always, emeralds 3 in 4), the map chest has the buried treasure map

buried_treasure.note: only with the map from a shipwreck: block 9,9 of the chunk with the X, a few blocks down in the beach

desert_pyramid.note: dig down beside the blue terracotta, never onto the pressure plate; 9 TNT under it

jungle_pyramid.note: two chests, tripwires and arrow dispensers; break in through a wall

ruined_portal.note: the chest (flint and steel and obsidian 1 in 2, golden apple 1 in 5), gold blocks often lie about

village.note: about three chests a raid; also the bell, hay bales, beds, crops, job blocks

pillager_outpost.note: chest at the top of the tower, pillagers spawn there all the time

igloo.note: half have a basement under the carpet (golden apple always, a brewing stand)

fortress.note: saddle 1 in 3, gold, diamonds; blazes and wither skeletons

bastion_remnant.note: gold blocks, obsidian, crying obsidian; piglins anger when a chest opens

abandoned_camp.note: forests and taigas; the secret chest: iron and gold 3 in 4, a diamond 1 in 3

mineshaft.note: chest minecarts along the corridors (name tag 2 in 5); cave spider spawners

dungeon.note: a mossy room with a spawner, found by caving (music disc 1 in 3, name tag 1 in 4)

minecraft:spider.note: night and caves; stays (neutral) by day; quick and climbs - the chase is most of the fight (the leagues' night hunts for one: 238 s)

minecraft:cave_spider.note: only from the spawners in mineshafts

minecraft:creeper.note: night and caves; stays by day; hit and step back

minecraft:enderman.note: one in ten of the night's monsters, seen from afar on open land; a two-block pillar and hit its feet

minecraft:witch.note: one in a hundred of the night's monsters; swamp huts at night

minecraft:slime.note: swamps at night by the moon (none at new moon), slime chunks below y 40

minecraft:phantom.note: only after three nights without sleep

minecraft:silverfish.note: stronghold spawner, infested stone in windswept hills and mountains

minecraft:ghast.note: nether wastes, soul sand valleys, basalt deltas; over open lava

minecraft:piglin.note: nether wastes, crimson forests, bastions; neutral to gold wearers

minecraft:zoglin.note: a hoglin taken to the Overworld

minecraft:strider.note: on lava lakes and oceans of the Nether

minecraft:zombified_piglin.note: everywhere in nether wastes; the whole group turns on whoever hits one
